_meta.epistemics_warning: Observational findings, not ground truth. Re-validate on new checkpoints / ORT versions / EPs before relying on a finding to skip work.

findings.title: LayoutLMv3ForQuestionAnswering builds and perfs at L1 with zero code changes on existing PR #1174 infra; fp16 saves ~100MB RAM with no latency penalty.
findings.observation: rubentito/layoutlmv3-base-mpdocvqa (LayoutLMv3ForQuestionAnswering, document VQA extractive QA) built and perfed successfully on winml 0.2.0 / ORT 1.24.5 using architecture support from PR #1174 (merged 2026-07-23). Inputs: input_ids, attention_mask, bbox, pixel_values. Outputs: start_logits, end_logits. CPU perf (fp32): P50 341.35ms, avg 342.95ms, 2.92 sps, RAM +652MB. CPU perf (fp16): P50 341.44ms, avg 343.81ms, 2.91 sps, RAM +551MB. fp16 saves ~100MB RAM with no measurable latency penalty. OpenVINO EP was auto-selected even when CPU config was specified (observed in perf output). Analyze step was CLI-BLOCKED due to missing runtime rule parquet files — this is an infrastructure gap, not a model issue.

not_yet_tested_on: accelerator EPs (QNN, OpenVINO explicit, DML, CUDA, NvTensorRTRTX, MIGraphX, VitisAI)
L3 eval (document-question-answering eval not yet supported)

gotchas: OpenVINO EP auto-selected even with CPU config — perf numbers reflect OpenVINO execution, not pure CPU EP.
Analyze blocked by missing rule parquet files (infra issue tracked separately, not model-specific).
fp16 provides memory savings (~100MB) but no latency improvement on this CPU host; do not assume CPU fp16 speedup.
findings.mechanism_notes: OpenVINO auto-selection mechanism not investigated. Hypothesis: ORT session options or EP priority list defaults to OpenVINO when available. Would be falsified by running on a host without OpenVINO EP installed.
